items.title: OpenAI lowers valuation target, raises up to $30 billion
items.summary: OpenAI is closing in on a new funding round of up to $30 billion but has lowered its valuation target to get there. The article OpenAI lowers valuation target, raises up to $30 billion appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials
items.summary: Customers are letting AI agents use their credentials to access accounts at Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, and other major U.S. banks, sometimes without direct instructions. Morgan Stanley has blocked agents, while other banks are restricting access. Most plan to limit agents to read-only access. The article Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Google's Agent Compute Engine gives every Gemini agent its own hardware-isolated micro virtual machine
items.summary: With Agent Compute Engine, Google is introducing a runtime environment designed specifically for AI agents, while also expanding the governance capabilities that enable companies to manage agents in cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. The article Google's Agent Compute Engine gives every Gemini agent its own hardware-isolated micro virtual machine appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Only 13 percent of companies see real returns from AI, Gartner survey finds
items.summary: Only 13 percent of companies are getting real business value from their AI investments, according to a Gartner survey of 2,002 CIOs. At the same time, 51 percent expect AI to actually increase their operating costs. Yet 75 percent of CEOs plan to keep raising their technology budgets. items.title: Recursive shows first result of its AI-driven research process with Flint
items.summary: The AI startup Recursive is unveiling Flint, its first language model, a 40-billion-parameter MoE for local coding developed by former DeepMind researchers. It was created in four months using the company's in-house AI system, "Eureka Machine," which independently tests and optimizes architectures. Recursive has yet to prove whether this approach will actually lead to self-improving AI. The article Recursive shows first result of its AI-driven re

items.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items.summary: Security researchers at Symantec have found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models on the web and uses them to attack servers, steal databases, and install cryptominers on its own. It runs up to 100,000 steps without human input. The owner of the hijacked model gets stuck with the bill. items.title: OpenAI agents analyze mouse brain data in 32 minutes, a job that would take humans months
items.summary: OpenAI teamed up with PerturbAI and Scripps Research to deploy thousands of AI agents that analyzed biological data from millions of mouse cells. The article OpenAI agents analyze mouse brain data in 32 minutes, a job that would take humans months appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
items.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent that handles tasks on its own, even when the user is offline. The app is built on Claude Opus 5.5 and connects to services like Gmail, Slack, and Stripe through more than 6,000 connectors. It asks for approval before sensitive actions like payments. items.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol discovered a critical PHP vulnerability as part of the Patch the Planet initiative that could affect millions of websites. Security firm Wiz independently found the same flaw using Google's Gemini 4 Argon. OpenAI warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too. items.title: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
items.summary: Google Cloud is the first major cloud provider to offer Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI's GPTs on a single platform. At launch, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna are available as a private preview for enterprise customers.
